name: General Cubic Spline Interpolation
definition: A collection of third order polynomials defined by parameters B and C. It is continuous, symmetrical, and has a continuous derivative for all B and C. It reconstructs constant values correctly but does not guarantee conditions 4 (interpolation) and 6 (linear reconstruction) unless specific B/C constraints are met.
summary: General cubic spline interpolation uses piecewise third-order polynomials parameterized by B and C to ensure continuous first derivatives, distinguishing it from fourth-order families by simplifying the parameter space.
